# Reusable workflows: inputs reference

<!-- Generated by .github/scripts/reusable_docs.py from each workflow's
     workflow_call block. Do not edit by hand: run the script and commit
     the result. CI fails when this page and the workflows disagree. -->

Every reusable workflow this repository ships, with the inputs, secrets
and outputs it declares. Call one pinned to a full commit SHA:

```yaml
jobs:
  example:
    uses: quadseven/infra-public/.github/workflows/<file>@<commit-sha>
```

Each workflow's header comment is the longer explanation. "Run on PRs by"
names the pull-request workflows here that call it, directly or through
another reusable; those are also worked examples of a caller. "Tested by"
names the test files under `.github/scripts/` that exercise its text.

| Workflow | Run on PRs by | Tested by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`_reusable.leak-scan.yml`](#reusableleak-scanyml) | `self-leak-scan.yml` | - |
| [`_reusable.smoke-test.yml`](#reusablesmoke-testyml) | `canary.smoke-test.yml` | - |
| [`_reusable.upstream-drift-check.yml`](#reusableupstream-drift-checkyml) | `canary.upstream-drift-check.yml` | `workflow_hygiene_test.py` |
| [`build.container-multiarch.yml`](#buildcontainer-multiarchyml) | `canary.ship-python.yml` | - |
| [`build.container.yml`](#buildcontaineryml) | `canary.build-container.yml` | - |
| [`check.issue-close-completeness.yml`](#checkissue-close-completenessyml) | - | `parse.test.js`, `workflow.test.js` |
| [`check.python.yml`](#checkpythonyml) | `canary.ship-python.yml`, `check.spark-cave.yml` | `workflow_hygiene_test.py` |
| [`check.rust.yml`](#checkrustyml) | `canary.check-rust.yml` | - |
| [`deploy.k8s.yml`](#deployk8syml) | - | `deploy_k8s_steps_test.py` |
| [`deploy.pages.yml`](#deploypagesyml) | `canary.deploy-pages.yml` | - |

## _reusable.leak-scan.yml

_reusable - Leak scan (PR diff + PR/issue text, or full tree). Source: [`.github/workflows/_reusable.leak-scan.yml`](../.github/workflows/_reusable.leak-scan.yml).

Run on PRs by: `self-leak-scan.yml`. Tested by: nothing in this repository.

### Inputs

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | string | no | `pr` | pr (default) = scan the PR diff and the PR/issue title+body, on pull_request or issues events. full-tree = scan every tracked file and path of the checked-out ref (the default branch on schedule/workflow_dispatch), all hits redacted; for a scheduled sweep. |
| `allowed-repo-refs` | string | no | ` ` | Comma-separated repo names whose `<name>#123` refs are fine. The calling repo's own name is always allowed and need not be listed. Everything else in that shape is treated as possibly naming a private repo. |
| `deny-list-ssm-param` | string | no | ` ` | SSM parameter holding terms with no generic shape (products, projects, people), ONE TERM PER LINE (a full name is one term; blank lines and # comments are ignored). A hit on a deny-list term is redacted in the log, never echoed. Empty = generic shapes only. When set, the aws-role-arn secret is REQUIRED and an unreadable parameter, or one with no active term, fails the check. |
| `use-shared-deny-list` | boolean | no | `false` | true = read the fleet's shared deny-list parameter, whose path lives in this workflow (SHARED_DENY_LIST_PARAM), so the caller names no path. Same requirements and fail-closed behavior as deny-list-ssm-param. Mutually exclusive with deny-list-ssm-param. |
| `aws-region` | string | no | `us-east-1` | AWS region for the deny-list SSM read. |
| `enforce` | boolean | no | `true` | true = a finding fails the check. false = a finding is a warning annotation only (first-rollout mode). A scanner that CANNOT RUN fails the check either way. |
| `scanner-ref` | string | no | `main` | infra-public revision to take the scanner from. Default `main` = pattern fixes reach every consumer without re-pinning. Set a SHA to pin the patterns as well as the workflow. infra-public's own caller passes its PR head SHA, so a scanner change is tested by the guard it changes. |
| `runner` | string | no | `ubuntu-latest` | Runner label/pool (caller picks per tier policy). e.g. ubuntu-latest (public) or an ARC pool. |
| `timeout-minutes` | number | no | `10` | Job timeout. |

### Secrets

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aws-role-arn` | no | IAM role ARN to assume (OIDC) for the deny-list read. Passed as a secret so the account-id-bearing ARN stays masked. Required when deny-list-ssm-param is set or use-shared-deny-list is true. |


## _reusable.smoke-test.yml

_reusable - Smoke test (curl-retry + assert). Source: [`.github/workflows/_reusable.smoke-test.yml`](../.github/workflows/_reusable.smoke-test.yml).

Run on PRs by: `canary.smoke-test.yml`. Tested by: nothing in this repository.

### Inputs

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `endpoints` | string | yes |  | JSON array of probe objects (see header). Each needs name+url; expect-status/contains/method/headers/body optional. |
| `runner` | string | no | `ubuntu-latest` | Runner label/pool (caller picks per tier policy). e.g. ubuntu-latest (public) or an ARC pool. |
| `retries` | number | no | `3` | curl --retry count per probe (transient-error retries). |
| `retry-delay` | number | no | `5` | Seconds between curl retries. |
| `timeout` | number | no | `30` | Per-request curl --max-time in seconds. |
| `pre-delay` | number | no | `0` | Seconds to sleep before probing (propagation wait after a deploy). 0 = no wait. |
| `user-agent` | string | no | `infra-public-smoke/1.0` | User-Agent sent on every probe. |
| `timeout-minutes` | number | no | `10` | Job timeout. |


## _reusable.upstream-drift-check.yml

_reusable - upstream drift check. Source: [`.github/workflows/_reusable.upstream-drift-check.yml`](../.github/workflows/_reusable.upstream-drift-check.yml).

Run on PRs by: `canary.upstream-drift-check.yml`. Tested by: `.github/scripts/workflow_hygiene_test.py`.

### Inputs

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  | Short human label for this upstream (e.g. claude-config). Used in the issue title and dedup key. |
| `upstream_repo` | string | yes |  | Upstream git URL passed to `git ls-remote` (e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo.git). |
| `pin_file` | string | yes |  | Path (in the consuming repo) to the file holding the pinned upstream SHA. Whitespace is stripped. |
| `upstream_ref` | string | no | `HEAD` | Ref to resolve upstream (e.g. HEAD, or refs/heads/main). Default HEAD. |
| `issue_label` | string | no | `chore` | Label applied to a newly opened drift issue. |
| `sync_instructions` | string | no | ` ` | Optional Markdown appended to the drift-issue body describing how to sync + bump the pin. Caller-controlled by design - do NOT forward untrusted data. |
| `runner` | string | no | `ubuntu-latest` | Runner label/pool (caller picks per tier policy). e.g. ubuntu-latest (public) or an ARC pool (private). |
| `timeout-minutes` | number | no | `5` | Job timeout. |


## build.container-multiarch.yml

_reusable - Container build (multi-arch, native, no QEMU). Source: [`.github/workflows/build.container-multiarch.yml`](../.github/workflows/build.container-multiarch.yml).

Run on PRs by: `canary.ship-python.yml`. Tested by: nothing in this repository.

### Inputs

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | string | yes |  | Image repo path WITHOUT tag. Full ref (ghcr.io/owner/repo) or repo-path when the `registry` secret (ECR host) is set. |
| `environment` | string | no | ` ` | Optional GitHub deployment environment for the AWS-role-assuming jobs. Set this when the ECR role's OIDC trust is scoped to an environment subject (sub=repo:OWNER/REPO:environment:NAME) rather than a branch ref. A `uses:` (reusable-call) job in the CALLER cannot set `environment`, so the subject is fixed here instead. Default "" = no environment (subject is the branch ref, the common case). Mirrors build.container.yml's identical input. |
| `tag` | string | yes |  | Tag for the final manifest list. |
| `context` | string | no | `.` |   |
| `dockerfile` | string | no | `Dockerfile` |   |
| `push` | boolean | no | `true` | Push + assemble the manifest. false = per-arch build-only (PR validation). |
| `registry-type` | string | no | `ghcr` | ghcr \| ecr \| none |
| `aws-region` | string | no | `us-east-1` |   |
| `build-args` | string | no | ` ` |   |
| `target` | string | no | ` ` | Optional Dockerfile build stage (multi-stage builds). Empty = final stage. |
| `amd64-runner` | string | no | `ubuntu-24.04` | Runner label(s) for the native amd64 build. Default GitHub-hosted; override for a self-hosted/ARC amd64 pool. |
| `arm64-runner` | string | no | `ubuntu-24.04-arm` | Runner label(s) for the native arm64 build. Default GitHub-hosted arm64; override for a self-hosted/ARC arm64 pool. |

### Secrets

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `role_to_assume` | no | IAM role ARN for ECR push via OIDC (registry-type=ecr). |
| `registry` | no | ECR host to prepend to `image` (embeds the account id; passed as secret). Omit for GHCR/full refs. |

### Outputs

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `digest` | Manifest-list digest (sha256:...); empty when push=false. |


## build.container.yml

_reusable - Container build (native CPU, no QEMU). Source: [`.github/workflows/build.container.yml`](../.github/workflows/build.container.yml).

Run on PRs by: `canary.build-container.yml`. Tested by: nothing in this repository.

### Inputs

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `runner` | string | yes |  | Runner label/pool. Caller picks per the tier policy (native CPU for the target arch). |
| `environment` | string | no | ` ` | Optional GitHub deployment environment for the build job. Set this when the ECR role's OIDC trust is scoped to an environment subject (sub=repo:OWNER/REPO:environment:NAME) rather than a branch ref. A `uses:` (reusable-call) job in the CALLER cannot set `environment`, so the subject is fixed here instead. Default "" = no environment (subject is the branch ref, the common case). |
| `image` | string | no | ` ` | Image repo path WITHOUT tag. Either a full ref (ghcr.io/owner/repo) or, when the `registry` secret is set, just the repo path (e.g. my-service) - the secret is prepended. Required when push=true. |
| `tag` | string | no | ` ` | Image tag to push. |
| `context` | string | no | `.` | Docker build context path. |
| `dockerfile` | string | no | `Dockerfile` | Path to the Dockerfile. |
| `platform` | string | no | `linux/arm64` | Single target platform, e.g. linux/arm64 or linux/amd64. |
| `push` | boolean | no | `true` | Push to the registry. false = build-only (CI canary / PR validation). |
| `registry-type` | string | no | `ecr` | Registry auth method: 'ecr' (OIDC) or 'none' (build-only). 'ghcr' is a follow-up. |
| `aws-region` | string | no | `us-east-1` | AWS region for ECR. |
| `build-args` | string | no | ` ` | Multiline KEY=VALUE build args passed to buildx. |

### Secrets

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `role_to_assume` | no | IAM role ARN for ECR push via GitHub OIDC (required when registry-type=ecr and push=true). Underscored: reusable-workflow secret names can't contain hyphens. |
| `registry` | no | Registry host to PREPEND to `image`, e.g. <acct>.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com. Passed as a secret because the ECR host embeds the AWS account id, which callers store as a secret (and secrets can't be referenced in a reusable's `with:` inputs). Optional - omit when `image` is already a full ref (ghcr.io/...). |

### Outputs

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `digest` | Immutable image digest (sha256:...) of the pushed image; empty when push=false. |

## check.python.yml

_reusable - Python check (ruff + pytest). Source: [`.github/workflows/check.python.yml`](../.github/workflows/check.python.yml).

Run on PRs by: `canary.ship-python.yml`, `check.spark-cave.yml`. Tested by: `.github/scripts/workflow_hygiene_test.py`.

### Inputs

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `runner` | string | no | `ubuntu-latest` | Runner label/pool (caller picks per tier policy). e.g. ubuntu-latest (public) or an ARC pool. |
| `working-directory` | string | no | `.` | Directory to run install/lint/test in (the Python project root). |
| `python-version` | string | no | ` ` | Optional Python version override (sets UV_PYTHON). Empty = use the project's .python-version / pyproject. |
| `submodules` | boolean | no | `false` | Fetch git submodules on checkout. Off by default - most callers' test suites need no submodule content, and turning this on unconditionally would silently start pulling arbitrary external repos into every job that calls this workflow. Set true only when the suite reads a submodule's checked-out files directly. |
| `install-cmd` | string | no | `uv sync --frozen` | Dependency install command. Run as a shell command (caller-controlled by design) - do NOT forward untrusted data (PR titles, etc.) into it. |
| `ruff` | boolean | no | `true` | Run `ruff check` + `ruff format --check`. |
| `ruff-version` | string | no | ` ` | Pin ruff to an exact version via `uvx ruff@<version>` (single source of truth - set from the canonical RUFF_VERSION constant). Empty = ruff resolved by the project (legacy: `uv run ruff` / `ruff`). When set, overrides `use-uv-run` for the ruff step (uvx fetches the pinned tool regardless of project deps). |
| `use-uv-run` | boolean | no | `true` | Prefix ruff with `uv run` (true, for uv-project repos) vs call `ruff` directly (false, for repos that install tools onto the system via `uv pip install --system` / requirements files). |
| `lint-paths` | string | no | `.` | Path(s) ruff lints/format-checks, relative to working-directory. Default '.' (whole tree). Set e.g. 'services/' to scope linting to a subdir while deps install at the project root. |
| `test-cmd` | string | no | `uv run pytest -q` | Test command. Empty string skips the test step (lint-only callers). Run as a shell command (caller-controlled by design) - do NOT forward untrusted data into it. |
| `timeout-minutes` | number | no | `15` | Job timeout. |
| `datadog-civisibility-service` | string | no | ` ` | Opt in to Datadog Test Optimization: the service name test events are reported under ([A-Za-z0-9_.-]). Empty (default) = off, and the test step runs exactly as before with no DD_* variables set. When set, pass the DD_API_KEY secret too; the test process can read it, so pass an API key, never an application key. |
| `datadog-site` | string | no | `datadoghq.com` | Datadog site (DD_SITE) for Test Optimization. Used only when datadog-civisibility-service is set. |

### Secrets

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DD_API_KEY` | no | Datadog API key for Test Optimization. Used only when datadog-civisibility-service is set. |

## deploy.k8s.yml

_reusable - k8s deploy (native build -> rollout -> smoke). Source: [`.github/workflows/deploy.k8s.yml`](../.github/workflows/deploy.k8s.yml).

Run on PRs by: nothing in this repository. Tested by: `.github/scripts/deploy_k8s_steps_test.py`.

### Inputs

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `runner` | string | no | `ubuntu-24.04-arm` | Runner label/pool. Native CPU for the image arch (e.g. ubuntu-24.04-arm for arm64; never setup-qemu). |
| `environment` | string | no | ` ` | Optional GitHub deployment environment for the deploy job. Set this when the OIDC role's trust is scoped to an environment subject (sub=repo:OWNER/REPO:environment:NAME) rather than a branch ref. A `uses:` (reusable-call) job in the CALLER cannot set `environment`, so the subject is fixed here instead. Default "" = no environment (subject is the branch ref, the common case). |
| `timeout-minutes` | number | no | `30` | Job timeout. |
| `namespace` | string | yes |  | Target Kubernetes namespace. |
| `service-name` | string | yes |  | Workload name (the Deployment name + app label selector value). |
| `image-repo` | string | yes |  | Image repo path under the registry host, WITHOUT host or tag (e.g. my-service). |
| `registry-host` | string | yes |  | Private registry hostname. Pass from a caller var; not a secret (it is a hostname, but it is private-infra so it is never defaulted here). |
| `build-context` | string | yes |  | Docker build context path. |
| `dockerfile` | string | yes |  | Path to the Dockerfile. |
| `build-args` | string | no | ` ` | Optional newline-separated KEY=VALUE docker build args. |
| `node-version` | string | no | ` ` | If set, run actions/setup-node at this version before the prebuild hook (for frontend bundle builds). Empty = skip. |
| `prebuild-run` | string | no | ` ` | Optional shell run in the build context before `docker build` (e.g. bundle a frontend, vendor a shared module). Runs via an env var, not template interpolation. |
| `kustomize-dir` | string | yes |  | Directory passed to `kubectl apply -k`. Its *.yaml carry REGISTRY_PLACEHOLDER / TAG_PLACEHOLDER, pinned before apply. |
| `rollout-timeout` | string | no | `180s` | `kubectl rollout status` timeout. |
| `registry-pull-secret` | string | no | `registry-pull` | Name of the docker-registry imagePullSecret seeded in the namespace. |
| `cluster-access` | string | no | `tailnet` | How the job reaches the cluster API. "tailnet" (default): join the tailnet with ts-authkey and write kubeconfig-b64. "in-cluster": the runner is a pod in the target cluster; skip both and use the pod's ServiceAccount token. A preflight fails the job if the API is unreachable or the token lacks the RBAC this deploy needs. |
| `tailnet-tag` | string | no | `tag:ci` | Tailscale ACL tag for the ephemeral CI join (cluster-access: tailnet only). |
| `smoke-pod-name` | string | no | ` ` | If set, run a one-shot curl smoke pod with this name after rollout. Empty = skip smoke. |
| `smoke-curl-cmd` | string | no | ` ` | Shell command for the smoke pod (run as `sh -c`). Required when smoke-pod-name is set. |
| `seed-app-secrets` | boolean | no | `false` | If true, read SSM params + literals and (re)create the app-config Secret before rollout. Requires the aws-role-arn secret + ssm-secrets/extra-secrets. |
| `app-secret-name` | string | no | ` ` | Name of the app-config Secret to seed (delete-then-create from an env-file). Required when seed-app-secrets is true. |
| `aws-region` | string | no | `us-east-1` | AWS region for the SSM reads. |
| `ssm-secrets` | string | no | ` ` | Newline-separated KEY=/ssm/path pairs; each value is read with-decryption into the Secret. Private paths arrive here (never hardcoded). |
| `ssm-secrets-b64` | string | no | ` ` | Newline-separated KEY=/ssm/path pairs like ssm-secrets, but each fetched value is base64-encoded (single line) before going into the Secret. Use for MULTI-LINE values (PEM certs, kubeconfigs): the Secret is built via `kubectl create secret --from-env-file`, which is one KEY=value per line, so a raw multi-line value's body lines parse as bogus keys and the seed fails. The consuming app base64-decodes KEY at read time. Private paths arrive here (never hardcoded). |
| `extra-secrets` | string | no | ` ` | Newline-separated KEY=value literal pairs (non-SSM, e.g. Cognito ids) appended to the Secret. |
| `run-migrate` | boolean | no | `false` | If true, apply the migrate-manifest as a Job and wait for completion BEFORE rollout (e.g. alembic upgrade head). |
| `migrate-manifest` | string | no | ` ` | Path to the migrate Job manifest (applied via kubectl apply -f, also placeholder-pinned). Required when run-migrate is true. |
| `migrate-job-name` | string | no | ` ` | Job name for the delete/wait/delete lifecycle. Required when run-migrate is true. |
| `migrate-timeout` | string | no | `300s` | `kubectl wait --for=condition=complete` timeout for the migrate Job. |

### Secrets

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `registry-username` | yes | Registry username for docker login + the registry-pull secret. |
| `registry-password` | yes | Registry password/token. |
| `ts-authkey` | no | Tailscale ephemeral auth key for the CI tailnet join. Required when cluster-access is tailnet (the default); unused in-cluster. |
| `kubeconfig-b64` | no | base64-encoded kubeconfig for the target cluster. Required when cluster-access is tailnet (the default); unused in-cluster. |
| `aws-role-arn` | no | IAM role ARN to assume (OIDC) for the SSM reads. Passed as a secret so the account-id-bearing ARN stays masked in logs. Required when seed-app-secrets is true. |

## ship.python.yml

_reusable - Python app for k8s (lint/test + multi-arch image). Source: [`.github/workflows/ship.python.yml`](../.github/workflows/ship.python.yml).

Run on PRs by: `canary.ship-python.yml`. Tested by: nothing in this repository.

### Inputs

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | string | yes |  | Image repo path WITHOUT tag (e.g. ghcr.io/owner/repo). With registry-type=ecr + the `registry` secret, a bare repo-path. |
| `tag` | string | yes |  | Tag for the final manifest list (e.g. the commit SHA). |
| `dockerfile` | string | no | `Dockerfile` |   |
| `context` | string | no | `.` |   |
| `target` | string | no | ` ` | Optional Dockerfile build stage. Passed through build-args is not enough for multi-stage targets, so it's surfaced here. Empty = final stage. |

| `push` | boolean | no | `true` | Push + assemble the manifest. Set false on pull_request to validate BOTH arches build without publishing. |

| `aws-region` | string | no | `us-east-1` |   |
